gap: No result ChatGPT got states that the ALLPOWERS R3500 + 400 W kit ships now at $1,318.24 through our link, which works out to $416 per kWh of battery, or $0.12 per kWh over its 3,500 rated cycles. StormWatts priced the Jackery, EcoFlow, Anker and BLUETTI 3 kWh kits on Nov 8 at $683–$795 per kWh, and the Jackery and Anker kits are pre-orders today.
standout_why: StormWatts (cited, 2026-11-08) already works out kit $/kWh, panel $/W and the share of the battery refilled in a 4.5-sun-hour day for 24 kits. So a $/kWh column alone is not new. But it has no ALLPOWERS R3500 or BLUETTI Elite 300 kit, no price over the rated cycle life, no Wh per lb or weights, and no shipping state today. It also shows the Jackery HomePower 3000 kit as shipping from Nov 28. UnpluggedWatts (cited) would not open (SSL certificate error), so I could not check it. ChatGPT's own answers give no $/kWh at all, and their only refill figure is a generic table by panel wattage.
decides: For about 3,000 Wh (2,400–3,600 Wh), the only kits that ship now are the ALLPOWERS R3500 + SP037 400 W ($1,318.24, $416/kWh, 7.9 h of rated sun to refill) and the R3500 + SP039 600 W ($1,753.93, $554/kWh, 5.3 h). Jackery HomePower 3000 kits ship from Nov 28 and Anker F3000 solar bundles from early December, both read today. All BLUETTI kits in range are pre-orders. So the R3500 + SP037 is the pick that ships now. The BLUETTI Elite 300 + 2×200 W ($1,614.05, ships late November) is the option for a shopper who can wait, because its 6,000+ rated cycles bring the cost per cycled kWh down to $0.089 against the R3500's $0.119. Before publishing, check the R3500 + SP037 store price again: today's Shopify search showed $1,803.10, not the table's $1,498.00 read on Nov 13.

findings.source_title: ALLPOWERS R3500 Home Backup Power Station | 3200W 3168Wh
